data.completion_memo: Root cause: the bundled "Delegated Code Review" graph (input → tool → approval → external_agent → output → completion) had no agent or model_call node, but the Run start path derives its single provider/model binding from graph_model_tier_ids (agent/model_call only) and refuses a graph with none: "workflow 'workflow.delegated-code-review' has no model-consuming node". Fix: inserted a model_call node "brief.1" (tier:balanced, maximumTokens 1024) between the approval gate and the external_agent, rewired the edges (e.gate.brief, e.brief.review) and updated the external_agent instructions/comments; the example copy was regenerated to match the template document exactly. Regression guards: the native every_bundled_json_workflow_is_executable test now also asserts each non-empty bundled workflow has an agent or model_call node, and the TS coverage test gained a matching "gives every bundled workflow a model-consuming node" case (the native catalog alone did not catch this). Docs: docs/workflow-node-showcase.md now lists model_call for this workflow and names the real native test (the old reference pointed at a non-existent every_seeded_json_workflow_is_executable), and the examples README describes the brief step. Verified: npx vitest run src/workbench (35 files, 317 tests passed) and cargo test --lib every_bundled_json_workflow_is_executable (1 passed). Note: the run first hit an environmental LNK1104 in the default TEMP dir; rerunning with a workspace-local TMP succeeded. A user whose Documents\Aworkit\Example Workflows\delegated-code-review.aworkit.json was already copied must delete and re-copy (or re-import) it, since Aworkit only writes missing example files.
data.description: The bundled "Delegated Code Review" workflow (input → tool scan → approval → external_agent → output → completion) contains no agent or model_call node, so the runtime refuses to start it: "workflow 'workflow.delegated-code-review' has no model-consuming node". Root cause: graph_model_tier_ids only counts agent/model_call nodes, and the bundled template omits both. Fix the template (and its byte-identical example copy) by inserting a model_call node that drafts the delegation brief after the approval gate, then add regression guards and update the docs that enumerate the workflow's nodes.
data.title: Fix Delegated Code Review template: add the missing model-consuming node
